durabilityDescription: Enable weapon wear mechanics on shots.
lossDescription: By default 1 durability is spent per 10 shots. Unreliable weapons spend twice as much, Reliable — half.
qualityDescription: Weapons added via Loot have random durability from 1 to 100. Merchant weapons are always 100%.
unarmedDescription: The unarmed attack (fists/manipulator) is always in the first slot; this toggle controls its display on the equipment screen.
cardsDescription: How weapons are displayed on the equipment screen.
